text: INTERPRETER (tree and VM): axon-ceiling/1 gains the required key `ai_calls`; under a ceiling with a whole number there, the model call past that count (ai_complete and every ai_extract::<T> alike) stops the run with E1303 (exit 5) before dispatch. A ceiling file without the key is now refused with E1007 (exit 2). Runs with no ceiling are unchanged.
